title: A changing world. A map in progress.
content:
Technology reshapes how we work and think. Institutions are tested, cultures shift, and ideas that once felt settled become open questions. These changes do not happen in isolation, and understanding one often means looking beyond it.

To navigate this world, we need more than a stream of information. We need context: a way to connect ideas, question assumptions, and understand how the pieces fit together.

This library is my attempt to build that understanding. It brings together essays across different fields, following the connections between them. Not a finished map or a set of final answers, but a record of thinking, learning, and revising.
